assertions.description: Output file is substantive (>1000 bytes) — a scannable 2-3 page prep document, not a stub
Output word count falls within a 2-3 page scannable range (roughly 300-1600 words) — not the old 8-10 page format
Output contains a Guest Research Brief section
Questions are numbered and at least 7 main questions are present
Main question numbering does not run past 10 (7-10 concrete questions, not an open-ended list)
Output contains a Suggested Flow section capturing what the guest will actually say

assertions.pattern: (?i)(prior transcript|conversation transcript|research-based inference|no prior transcript found)
assertions.description: Notes section discloses whether questions came from a real conversation transcript or research-based inference — guards against presenting inferred/fabricated content as verified fact
Output does not contain em dashes
